english.title: Spitting within Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) spat

(A)_[on the floor, side or wall of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..),]_
(B)_[on the floor, side or wall of a passenger transit system , namely **(..SPECIFY TRANSIT SYSTEM..),]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3.18 and 2.1 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
